title: Single-source the wolf_winter id coupling threaded through engine core
body:
wolf_winter identifiers are hardcoded across ~18 src files: src/core/embedded_launch_overlay_receipt.ts pins pack id "wolf_winter_v1", flag "dispatch_opening_delayed", and schema literal world_quest_id: "wolf_winter"; both validators special-case it (rpg_validator.ts:42, rpg_foundation_validator.ts:28,201-205); src/world/wolf_hill_route_presentation.ts and the pure-mode Station/June narrowing in src/mcp/server.ts (~:616-620) carry more literals. Renaming the pack or quest id would silently sever the dispatch-overlay pathway (the schema literal rejects) and quietly disable the pure-mode narrowing (which falls back gracefully but stops working).

Proposal: one exported constants module (or registry-driven binding) for the wolf-winter campaign coupling that every consumer imports, so a rename is a one-line change the type system propagates. The receipt schema literal can derive from the constant.

From the 2026-08-30 full audit, findings ledger P2.

evidence.summary: 2026-08-30 audit: content ids name-coupled into 18 engine files
